That segment is therefore unexempted unless a clause excuses it.

No exemption applies. RD-4 requires a traffic incident on the replaced stretch of the optimal route, reported before the detour; the trace marks this ✗ and the record confirms no incident near the route in the trip window, with the only congestion records at speed band 5 (40–49 km/h) on ECP and Airport Boulevard — not bands 1–2 and, per RD-4(b), corroborative at most [F13][F11][F12][F14][RD-4].
